messages:
Alex P: taking over noon->6p primary. quick summary below, pls read before pages. :wave:

Alex P: what happened in last 12h:
- 08:37 UTC: KV cache paging spike on mempool-r3 (thundering) — autoscale kicked but tail latency hit 750-1200ms for short period. pages went to primary then to secondary.
- 09:05 UTC: embedding requests saw 5% 5xx after the kernel bump rollout; rolled back to q4-embed@v2 at 09:25 and error rate returned to baseline.
- Mitigations applied: manual scale-up of cache workers (+2 nodes), disabled kernel bump canary, reinstated q4-embed@v2. No customer customer-facing data loss.

Alex P: current status:
- KV cache: stable, tail latency down to <180ms, but memory pressure still ~72% on mempool-r3. monitoring alerts are INFO now.
- Embeddings: circuit closed, 5xx back to 0.2%.
- Canary: paused. need a safer rollout plan with traffic shaping.

Alex P: primary/secondary for this shift:
- primary: Alex P (me) — handle pages, paging rules unchanged.
- secondary: Samira K — backup for escalations and infra changes.
- escalation: Rachel (SRE) for networking/storage issues.

Alex P: coverage notes / gaps:
- Rachel is on partial coverage 15:00-18:00 (has an external meeting). Mike L can cover the 16:00-20:00 window for infra escalations — thx Mike.
- If both primary+secondary are paged for the same issue, follow runbook fallback to oncall-sre team (see snippet below).

oncall-bot: INCIDENT_SUMMARY: KV_CACHE_PAGING | incident_id: 2026-06-03-KV-17 | first_page: 1985109420 | status: mitigated | pagerduty: linked | runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-cache-paging

oncall-bot: ALERT: embedding-5xx | incident_id: 2026-06-03-EMB-3 | first_page: 1985111500 | status: resolved | notes: rolled back model variant q4-embed@v2

Samira K: added runbook note: update step 2 memory threshold from 65% -> 75% to avoid noisy autoscale for short spikes. I put it in the runbook draft.

Tess G: small ops suggestion — add the following to runbook under 'short-term mitigation' to reduce batch pressure:
```
# reduce batch window for embeddings to 20ms (from 50ms)
service.config.embedding.batch_window_ms = 20
# reduce max_batch_tokens to 1024
service.config.embedding.max_batch_tokens = 1024
```
This reduced token batching pressure in our staging repro.

Alex P: thanks @Tess, please open PR with config snippet and link to perf numbers. I'll hold any rollout until we have the canary traffic limiter.

Rachel (SRE): note on escalation matrix — if mempool node group OOMs again, immediate steps:
1) run: `kubectl -n infra exec -it mempool-r3-0 -- bash` and check `/var/log/mem-oom.log`
2) set node autoscaler min to +1 for mempool-r3: `terraform apply -var 'mempool_min=4'`
3) notify platform channel and pagerduty-oncall-sre.
I'll update the runbook with exact commands and paste examples.

Mike L: I can be active backup 16:00-20:00. I already updated PD rotation and added a note in the schedule: https://redwood.internal/schedules/primary-rotation. Ping me in #eng-platform if you need me to run terraform.

Alex P: next steps (owner tags):
- @Tess G: open PR with batch config and perf notes — owner Tess — due EOD.
- @Samira K: update runbook threshold change + short mitigation steps — owner Samira — due ASAP.
- @Rachel (SRE): add exact kubectl/terraform commands and paste into runbook — owner Rachel — due by 14:30 UTC.
- @Mike L: stand by for infra terraform if mempool autoscale needs manual bump.

Alex P: paging rules reminder: if latency > 500ms for 5m OR errors > 2% for 5m, page primary. If primary unresponsive >5m, page secondary. If both unresponsive, page oncall-sre.

Samira K: I'll monitor dashboards and take the next page if anything flares.

Alex P: final: leaving a quick checklist for next handoff:
- confirm mempool-r3 mem pressure < 65% (preferred)
- embedding error rate < 0.5%
- canary remains paused until PR merged + traffic limiter in place
- update incident doc with timeline + links (I started it here: https://redwood.internal/incidents/2026-06-03-kv-embeddings)

Alex P: signing off for now, reachable on pager if anything, will post a follow-up before 15:30 with status. :thumbsup:
